name: concealment
description: Furniture that hides other furniture behind a passcode. A disguise piece (flags.conceal_hides = the hidden piece's id, flags.conceal_code = its factory code) sits in a room looking innocent while the piece it names carries flags.concealed and is left out of the room description entirely by the engine's own filter. `keypad` opens a private client keypad; the right code pivots the disguise on a turntable and rolls the hidden piece out where the WHOLE ROOM can see it. The digits are private (the overlay submits silently); the reveal is not.

keypad.note: The panel on a disguise piece. Surfaced by the specialized action registered under requiredFlag conceal_hides, and as an action-link on examine.

concealcode.note: Client transport only — the keypad overlay's submit, sent silently so the digits never reach the log. Players use `keypad`.

concealsetcode.note: Client transport only — the overlay's change-code panel (old code + new). Reached through `keypad`, never typed.
